# SSDown — Free Online Tools for Everyday Tasks
> Free browser-based tools for image editing, PDF management, video conversion, file transformation, and software discovery. No installation required. Fast, secure, and privacy-first.

## Tools Overview
- /tools: Browse all tools by category

## Image Tools
- /image/image-compressor: Compress PNG, JPG, WebP images without quality loss
- /image/image-converter: Convert images between PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP formats
- /image/social-image-resizer: Resize images for Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn
- /image/watermark-remover: Remove watermarks from images
- /image/favicon-generator: Generate favicon from any image
- /image/color-palette-extractor: Extract dominant color palette from images
- /image/thumbnail-generator: Generate thumbnails for video and blog content
- /image/background-remover: Remove image backgrounds automatically
- /image/crop-image: Crop images to custom dimensions
- /image/flip-image: Flip or mirror images horizontally or vertically
- /image/pixelate-image: Pixelate or blur regions of an image
- /image/black-and-white: Convert images to black and white
- /image/add-text-to-image: Add text overlays to images
- /image/add-border-to-image: Add borders and frames to images
- /image/combine-images: Combine multiple images side by side
- /image/collage-maker: Create photo collages
- /image/round-image-maker: Create circular or rounded images
- /image/image-metadata-viewer: View EXIF and metadata from images
- /image/blur-image: Apply blur effects to images
- /image/icon-to-png: Convert ICO icon files to PNG

## Video & Audio Tools
- /video-audio/video-to-mp3: Extract audio from video files and convert to MP3

- /video-audio/gif-to-mp4: Convert animated GIF to MP4 video

- /pdf/pdf-to-png: Convert PDF pages to PNG images
